Title of the Event:  
      Valedictory function  of One day Arts and Crafts workshop - “Come along and learn New Crafts ” 
sponsored by SPICES an AICTE initiative organized by Arts & Crafts club.  
Date of the Event:  
19-10-2022 (Saturday)  
 
Venue of the Event:  
10:00 AM to 5:00 PM  
Room No: 8403 
 
Event Coordinator:  
Dr. T Murari  
Associate Professor of English  
 Department of English, 
 SV College of Engineering,  
 
 
Chief Guest:  
Dr. N.Sudhakar Reddy 
Principal,  
SV College of Engineering, 
Tirupati, A.P. – 517507. 
Event Description:  
 Arts & Crafts club, SVCE with the support from department of English, organized one day workshop on   
“Come along and lea rn New Crafts”  to promote in terest and creativity and  develop artistic skills in craft 
making among students. The workshop started with prayer song and lighting the lamp by the dignitaries . Guest 
of honor Dr. K. Suneetha Reddy , Head, D epartment of English explained the value and importance of crafts. 
The chief guest  of the program  Dr. N. Sudhakar R eddy, Principal, S V College of Engineering emphasized the 
necessity of developing artistic skills and how it helps students in their career.  
           The resource person Mr. N. Yugesh, Artist & Founder, Eesha fine Arts Studio,  Tirupati elaborated the 
joy of art and explained the methods to be followed in art and craft making.  The workshop continued with 

making different kinds of crafts under the guidance and observation of the resource person. Students enjoyed 
the session and learned many techniques like how to make rough sketch and cutting the card boards  and 
thermocol sheets  to make impressive crafts , painting on crafts and toys made of water bottles for indoor 
decoration. Finally the principal Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy distributed the certificates. 
 Targeted Audience:  
1st, 2nd year EEE and CSE (AI&ML) Students.  
Total Number of Participants: 50
